scope: Public hydronic engineering principles, not an AWS/Google as-built design or data-center hardware qualification. Paraphrases only; original publishers retain their documents.

sources.title: US DOE / Hydraulic Institute: Improving Pumping System Performance, Second Edition
sources.location: Printed pages 51-53, section 11: Controlling Pumps with Adjustable Speed Drives (PDF pages 55-57)
sources.supports: Reducing excess pump output versus dissipating energy in throttle valves; speed-control limitations and operating-point review.
sources.application: Compare full-speed throttling with reduced-speed balancing using solved system intersections, not cube-law savings alone.

sources.title: Caleffi idronics 34, Introduction
sources.location: A naturally unbalanced system, Figures 1-2 and 1-3
sources.supports: Relative branch resistance and direct-return path length affect flow; balancing adds branch resistance.
sources.application: Near racks need more added loss than the far critical rack. Native cases verify the specific network.

sources.title: Danfoss ASV-PV DN50-100 datasheet
sources.supports: Differential-pressure regulation of a branch/riser with terminal flow limitation; pressure-regulating principle.
sources.application: Research-only alternative. Regulating a group differential pressure does not alone prescribe each rack flow.

sources.title: Danfoss AB-QM pressure-independent control valve datasheet
sources.location: Pages 1-2, function, flow range and differential-pressure operating range
sources.supports: Combined pressure regulator and flow/control function; required operating differential and rated flow depend on size.
sources.application: Research-only alternative. The study's 15 kPa valve floor is a static modeling assumption, not an AB-QM specification or selection.

sources.title: Caleffi: Single-Circulator Distribution Systems
sources.supports: Reverse-return approximates equal path resistance and improves inherent balance; real systems are not perfectly self-balancing.
sources.application: Research-only rerouting option. Requires new CAD lengths and network solve before any power claim.
